description: A typed WordPress REST client for a custom app (Node, server side only): application-password authentication from environment variables, JSON errors surfaced as exceptions, helpers for listing, reading and creating posts of a custom post type, and running an Ability.

placeholders.slug: the WordPress plugin slug (its rest_base is <slug>-items in the plugin template)
placeholders.prefix: the plugin's PHP prefix, e.g. book_club

next: Create an application password: wp user application-password create <admin user> app --porcelain, and put it in .env (never in browser code).
Import from server code only (API routes, server actions, SSR); never ship WP_APP_PASSWORD to the browser.
